faqs.q: Why does this book use nodriver instead of Selenium or Playwright?
faqs.a: Traditional tools like Selenium and standard Playwright configurations leave distinct browser fingerprints (e.g., navigator.webdriver=true) that are easily flagged by Cloudflare, DataDome, and Akamai. nodriver connects directly to Chrome's raw debugging port (CDP) using asynchronous Python, mimicking human-like browser initialization natively.
Python 3.10 or higher is recommended, as the codebase heavily leverages modern asynchronous features (asyncio) and typed dictionary parameters.
